name: Alfonso Morales
office: City of Lynwood, Member of the City Council

items.text: Alfonso Morales is an immigration attorney and president of the Lynwood Unified School District Board of Education. He opened his law office in Lynwood in 2008. He has served on the board since 2005, often as president. He announced he will retire from the board in December 2026.

sentences.text: Alfonso Morales is an immigration attorney and president of the Lynwood Unified School District Board of Education.
He opened his law office in Lynwood in 2008.
He has served on the board since 2005, often as president.
He announced he will retire from the board in December 2026.

items.text: His campaign says he will bring his experience as an educational leader and lawyer to strengthen public safety, support local businesses, improve city services, and protect quality of life. He pledges to protect residents and defend working families. In a campaign video, he said the community must be defended against Donald Trump.
